deposit.note: Zenodo record 10.5281/zenodo.21632264 (v1.0) holds the manuscripts and protocol battery, not these files; regenerate locally with `python data/generate_seeds.py` and check with `--verify`.

datasets.name: sim0_hep_proxy
datasets.v1_1_note: v1.1 registers N=115 primary plus an independent N>=30 validation sample and replaces heartbeat counting with discrimination; the seed keeps the v1.0 60-subject design and v1.0 Pred 0.A-0.C thresholds.

datasets.name: sim1_ignition_dynamics
datasets.v1_1_note: Trial-level model simulation; no participant count. v1.1 cohort (62 enrolled / 59 analyzable / 48 floor) is not simulated.

datasets.name: sim2_parameter_recovery
datasets.seed_design: 1 000 five-parameter MLE recovery runs x 200 trials
datasets.v1_1_note: v1.1 requires 1 000 deterministic seeds per condition across seven agent architectures; the seed is a single-model recovery sweep.

datasets.name: sim3_liquid_network
datasets.seed_design: 20 reservoir seeds x 500 steps x 100 units
datasets.v1_1_note: Paper 2 supplementary reservoir trajectories; no protocol cohort.

datasets.name: sim4_hierarchical
datasets.seed_design: 100 seeds x 50 trials x 5 hierarchy levels
datasets.v1_1_note: Model prediction-error series; v1.1 cohort (N=40 / 36 analyzable, 200 trials) is not simulated.

datasets.name: sim5_doc_biomarker
datasets.v1_1_note: Group sizes equal the v1.1 fixed-enrollment design (80 patients + 30 controls). Site structure (whole-site bootstrap) is not simulated.

datasets.name: sim6_bifurcation
datasets.v1_1_note: v1.1 registers N=20 target / 12 minimum clinical participants.

datasets.name: sim7_metabolic_crossover
datasets.v1_1_note: v1.1 registers N=64 / 55 analyzable / 48 floor across two labs with four sessions and a three-level contrast grid; the seed keeps the v1.0 2x2 design.

datasets.name: sim8_tms_pci
datasets.seed_design: N=36, three sites (aINS, dlPFC, vertex), pi_i tertiles
datasets.v1_1_note: N=36 equals the v1.1 analyzable floor; v1.1 targets 52 enrolled / 44 analyzable and adds the Pred 5.E ROPE equivalence test.
